# controld_user (Data Source)

Fetches details about the ControlD account tied to the configured API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_user" "me" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The account email address.
- `id` (String) The account identifier (PK).
- `proxy_access` (Boolean) Whether the account has proxy access.
- `resolver_uid` (String) The account's default resolver identifier.
- `rule_profile` (String) The identifier of the account's default profile.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the account is active.
- `twofa` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enabled on the account.
